_note: Public model providers the privacy gateway may use, in order. Every request is redacted first. The first entry uses the caller's own key (N.E.K.O's Dahl key). A fallback needs enabled=true, a model, and a key FILE NAME under D:\jarvis-secrets (the key itself never goes in this file). Free tiers change: check the provider's current terms (jarvis/docs/neko/evidence/06-models-hardware-providers.md section 9). Gemini's free tier is excluded for personal data (its terms allow training on it).

providers.name: claude
providers._note: Owner exception (2026-10-22): the Anthropic API credit is used for the planner until 2026-10-31, after which this entry is dropped by load_providers and Dahl answers alone. Plain chat calls only (no streaming, tools, images or response_format: those go to Dahl). Asked first; the redaction runs before it and placeholders are restored after. Token cap per request: max_tokens_cap. Billing past the credit goes to the owner's card, so the owner's stop is $90 of org spend.

providers.name: groq
providers._note: Owner's first fallback (2026-10-16). Inactive until D:\jarvis-secrets\providers\groq.key exists (skipped as 'no key file'). Base-plan limits on Groq's docs (2026-10-16): 30 requests/min, 1,000/day, 8K tokens/min for this model; over the limit Groq answers 429 (the gateway then moves on), it does not bill.
